# Yogya Chugh

> Software engineer in Delhi, India. Software Engineering Intern at Meant2Bae (paid, on-site, since 21 September 2026). Previously a paid, remote Software Developer intern at Vardhman Electricals, where Yogya built the Vardhman Saathi rewards platform end to end. Has a fix merged into Django and won a laptop in Hack Club's Summer of Making 2025. The site at yogya.dev tells all of this as a comic.

Key facts:

- Role: Software Engineer; Software Engineering Intern at Meant2Bae (a curated dating service for professionals in India), September 2026 to present.
- Freelance: since June 2026, building ScreenDemons (https://screendemons.app), an iOS and Android app that cuts screen time through challenges with friends.
- Vardhman Electricals (March to June 2026): built the Vardhman Saathi Android app (React Native, Expo), an Electron admin desktop app and the backend on Supabase and Cloudflare. 200+ people use it at once and hosting costs $0 a month.
- Open source: django/django pull request #19295, merged in March 2025, fixing a confusing error for unresolved relative {% extends %} template paths.
- Hack Club Summer of Making 2025: 450+ hours across 4 projects, 6,612 shells; won a Gigabyte Aero X16 laptop and $25 of Steam credit, plus Red Dead Redemption 2 and Far Cry 4.
- Projects: AnyStudio (native app builder written in Rust, in development), Webelo (C++ library implementing the WHATWG DOM standard), Pippo (multilingual robot guide, 3rd place and $50 at each of two international hackathons in 2025: University of Derby and Ulster University, UK), Timberly (Pygame game with an online leaderboard), Hangman in C, Snake Hustle.
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Panipat Institute of Engineering and Technology (Kurukshetra University), 2023 to 2027, CGPA 8.05/10.
- Skills: C++, Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL; React, React Native, Expo, Electron; FastAPI, Flask, Django, Node.js, Hono; PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1, KV, Pages; Docker, Git, Linux, GitHub Actions.
- Project sites: https://webelo.yogya.dev (Webelo), https://webber.yogya.dev (Webber), https://safario.yogya.dev (Safario), https://votes.yogya.dev (Vote Leaderboard), https://timberly.yogya.dev (Timberly), https://island.yogya.dev (Western Upside-Down Island), https://snake.yogya.dev (Snake Hustle).
- More projects (github.com/YogyaChugh): Webber (saves websites for offline reading, Python), Safario (blockchain tourist IDs for Smart India Hackathon, React and TypeScript), Ticket Chatbot (Rasa, Smart India Hackathon), Vote Leaderboard (Summer of Making voter rankings), Hangman (C).
- Leadership: founder and lead of PIET Comp Techies, the college technical club; organised Frontend Frenzy, a website-building contest (October 2024).
- Location: Delhi, India (IST, UTC+5:30). Open to freelance projects and collaborations.

## Blog posts

- [Running a real product for $0 a month](https://yogya.dev/blogs/vardhman): How Vardhman Saathi's Android app, admin app and backend run entirely on free tiers while serving 200+ people at once.
- [Implementing the WHATWG DOM in C++](https://yogya.dev/blogs/whatwg_dom): Building Webelo, a C++ DOM library that follows the WHATWG DOM Living Standard: the node tree, preorder traversal and event dispatch.
- [450 hours, 4 ships, one laptop](https://yogya.dev/blogs/summer_of_making): How a rejection from Google Summer of Code turned into Hack Club's Summer of Making: 450+ hours of coding, 6,612 shells and a new laptop.
- [My first open-source contribution](https://yogya.dev/blogs/first_open_source): How a confusing error in Django's template engine became Yogya Chugh's first merged pull request, django/django #19295.
